verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents bounce tracking, automatic complaint and bounce handling, open/click engagement tracking, an analytics web UI, event webhooks and Datadog analytics, plus an InboxReady inbox placement test using seed lists. A community comparison credits Mailgun's analytics over SES. Guidance beyond raw counts is thinly evidenced: sender reputation appears only through IP pool management, with no documented reputation scoring or recommendations. Missing for 10: explicit sender-reputation monitoring and actionable guidance, documented complaint-rate analytics, and hands-on corroboration of inbox placement insights.
